name: get_pdb_structure
description: Retrieve the 3D structure of a protein from the Protein Data Bank (PDB) using a PDB ID. Use this tool when you have a specific PDB ID (e.g. '1A2B') and need the corresponding structural data. Do NOT use this tool for searching or querying multiple structures; for that, consider using 'search_pdb_by_keyword'.

parameters.name: pdb_id
parameters.description: The PDB identifier, a 4-character alphanumeric code (e.g. '1A2B'). Must be a valid PDB ID; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_coordinates
parameters.description: Whether to include atomic coordinates in the response. Set to false to reduce response size when only metadata is needed. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: The format of the returned structure data. Must be one of: 'pdb', 'mmCIF'. Defaults to 'pdb'.

structure_metadata.description: Metadata about the structure, including title, authors, and resolution.

atomic_coordinates.description: List of atomic coordinates (x, y, z) for each atom in the structure. Only present if include_coordinates=true.

return_schema.description: Object containing the PDB ID, structure metadata, and optional atomic coordinates.
